user.title: Connect to Drink Morning Cloud
user.description: Enter the email and password for your Morning mobile application account to discover your coffee machine.

select_machine.title: Select Morning Machines
select_machine.description: Multiple machines were discovered on your account. Choose which ones to add to Home Assistant:

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate with Drink Morning
reauth_confirm.description: Please enter your Morning account password for {email} to renew your authentication session.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Morning cloud servers. Please check your internet connection.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid email or password. Please verify your credentials in the Drink Morning mobile app.
error.no_devices: No Morning machines found linked to this account. Please pair your machine in the official Morning mobile app first.
error.no_machine_selected: You must select at least one machine to continue.
error.unknown: Unexpected error occurred. Please check Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This Morning account is already configured.

init.title: Morning Coffee Machine Options
init.description: Configure reservoir capacity and polling interval for your Morning machine(s).

set_standby_timeout.name: Set Standby Timeout
set_standby_timeout.description: Updates the auto-sleep energy saving standby timeout on the Morning machine.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: Auto-sleep standby timer duration in seconds (between 300 and 7200).

reset_machine.name: Reset Machine
reset_machine.description: Triggers a software reset on the Morning Coffee Machine.

check_updates.name: Check Updates
check_updates.description: Checks the Morning cloud backend for available firmware updates.

refill_water.name: Refill Water Tank
refill_water.description: Resets or tops up estimated water level in the Morning Coffee Machine reservoir.

amount_ml.name: Amount
amount_ml.description: Volume in ml to add. If empty, resets tank to full capacity.

record_purge.name: Record Purge Rinse
record_purge.description: Decrements the estimated water level in the Morning Coffee Machine reservoir for a purge rinse.

amount_ml.name: Amount
amount_ml.description: Volume in ml to deduct. If omitted, uses configured purge volume.
